summary: Full end-to-end Playwright UI test of GMA Landing on the public preview URL. 21 distinct checks across home/nav/i18n/theme/contact/blog/admin-auth/admin-CRUD/mobile. All critical user flows PASS. Single false-negative on hero-text comparison (hero title is identical in ID and EN locales by design; lang switch verified via localStorage persistence, reload persistence, nav label changes visible in screenshot, and ID contact-toast text 'Terima kasih! Pesan Anda telah terkirim.').

issues: Hero H1 text appears to render slightly merged ('IntegratedTrading &Maritime Group') when read via text_content; likely due to responsive line-break spans without surrounding spaces. Visually fine but screen-readers may concatenate words. Consider adding explicit spaces or aria-label.

action_items: (Optional) Ensure hero H1 words are space-separated for a11y (accessibility reads 'IntegratedTrading &Maritime Group' without gaps).
(Optional) Expose [data-testid=why-card-*] and [data-testid=blog-preview-card-*] on home sections so future automated assertions can count cards directly. Visible in UI but not testable by testid.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminLogin.jsx prefills email with 'admin@gma.co.id' — convenient for demo but should be removed/flagged for production to avoid hinting at valid admin accounts.

api interceptor attaches Bearer token from localStorage (gma-token); works alongside httpOnly cookie. Fine for preview; document that cookie path is the canonical auth and localStorage is cross-origin fallback only.
Home page renders why-us and blog-preview cards without data-testid attributes on individual cards; counted 0 via testid probe though visible in UI. Add them for deterministic E2E coverage.
AdminDashboard BlogEditor has required=false for 'image' visually, but it is marked required in code. Keep consistent: either allow empty image or show required asterisk in the label.
Contact form success toast renders in the current UI locale (ID) even if user just switched EN→ID mid-session — works because onSubmit pulls t() live. Good.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on critical flows (21/21 after dismissing the false-negative text-equality check on a locale-identical title)

test_credentials: admin@gma.co.id / gma-admin-2024 — verified working via UI login flow
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted ephemeral TEST_POST_* blog entry and a TEST User contact submission during admin CRUD flow. Blog entry deleted in-flow; contact submission remains in DB (harmless, prefixed 'TEST User').
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL: https://multi-lang-portal-4.preview.emergentagent.com. Full regression script is inline in /app/test_reports/iteration_2.json summary; pattern = goto → wait_for_selector('[data-testid=navbar]') → interact via data-testid. Console shows 401s on /api/auth/me on anonymous pages — benign (AuthProvider probes session). All data-testid selectors per review_request are present and functional.
rca of the issue: No unresolved issues. The single failed assertion ('lang_switch_en') was a test-design artifact: the hero title string is identical in both locales, so comparing textContent pre/post toggle cannot detect the switch. Language switching itself works correctly (localStorage key updates, reload persists, nav labels change between 'TENTANG KAMI / LAYANAN / SEKTOR / BLOG / FAQ / HUBUNGI KAMI' and their English equivalents as observed in the mobile screenshot).
